# F0001 — Create item

Status: ready
Source: owner:demo, 2026-11-13

## Overview

A member creates an item so it appears in their list.

## Description

### Creating an item

The member enters a name and saves. A name is required and must be unique. Each
item has a display state. The owner can archive an item.

## Out of scope

- Editing an item.

## Decisions

| ID | Decision | Source | Status |
